import asyncio
from decimal import Decimal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.auth import get_current_user
from app.clients.payments import PaymentsClient
from app.db import get_db
from app.models import Order, User
from app.notifications import send_email

router = APIRouter(prefix="/orders", tags=["orders"])


def get_payments_client() -> PaymentsClient:
    return PaymentsClient()


class OrderItemOut(BaseModel):
    id: int
    product_id: int
    quantity: int

    model_config = {"from_attributes": True}


class OrderOut(BaseModel):
    id: int
    status: str
    total: Decimal
    payment_id: str | None
    items: list[OrderItemOut]

    model_config = {"from_attributes": True}


class RefundOut(BaseModel):
    order_id: int
    status: str
    refund_id: str
    refund_status: str


def _get_owned_order(order_id: int, user: User, db: Session) -> Order:
    order = db.get(Order, order_id)
    if order is None or order.user_id != user.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="order not found")
    return order


@router.get("/{order_id}", response_model=OrderOut)
async def get_order(
    order_id: int,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
) -> Order:
    return _get_owned_order(order_id, user, db)


@router.post("/{order_id}/refund", response_model=RefundOut)
async def refund_order(
    order_id: int,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    payments: PaymentsClient = Depends(get_payments_client),
) -> RefundOut:
    order = _get_owned_order(order_id, user, db)

    if order.status == "refunded":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="order already refunded")

    if not order.payment_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="order has no associated payment")

    refund = await asyncio.to_thread(payments.refund, order.payment_id, float(order.total))

    order.status = "refunded"
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(order)

    await asyncio.to_thread(
        send_email,
        user.email,
        "Your refund receipt",
        f"Order #{order.id} for {order.total} has been refunded. Refund ID: {refund.id}.",
    )

    return RefundOut(order_id=order.id, status=order.status, refund_id=refund.id, refund_status=refund.status)

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlalchemy import update
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, joinedload

from app.db import get_db
from app.models import Order, OrderItem, Product

router = APIRouter()


class ReserveRequest(BaseModel):
    quantity: int = Field(gt=0)


class RestockItem(BaseModel):
    product_id: int
    quantity: int = Field(gt=0)


class SaleReportItem(BaseModel):
    order_id: int
    created_at: datetime
    customer_name: str
    products: list[str]
    total: float


@router.post("/products/{product_id}/reserve")
def reserve_product(product_id: int, body: ReserveRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict[str, object]:
    result = db.execute(
        update(Product)
        .where(Product.id == product_id, Product.stock >= body.quantity)
        .values(stock=Product.stock - body.quantity)
    )
    if result.rowcount == 0:
        product = db.get(Product, product_id)
        if product is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="product not found")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="insufficient stock")
    db.commit()
    product = db.get(Product, product_id)
    return {"product_id": product.id, "stock": product.stock}


@router.post("/products/restock")
def restock_products(items: list[RestockItem], db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    ids = [item.product_id for item in items]
    existing_ids = {row[0] for row in db.query(Product.id).filter(Product.id.in_(ids)).all()}
    missing = sorted(set(ids) - existing_ids)
    if missing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"products not found: {missing}")

    for item in items:
        db.execute(
            update(Product).where(Product.id == item.product_id).values(stock=Product.stock + item.quantity)
        )
    db.commit()

    products = db.query(Product).filter(Product.id.in_(ids)).all()
    return [{"product_id": p.id, "stock": p.stock} for p in products]


@router.get("/reports/sales")
def sales_report(db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> list[SaleReportItem]:
    cutoff = datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=30)
    orders = (
        db.query(Order)
        .options(joinedload(Order.user), joinedload(Order.items).joinedload(OrderItem.product))
        .filter(Order.created_at >= cutoff)
        .all()
    )
    return [
        SaleReportItem(
            order_id=order.id,
            created_at=order.created_at,
            customer_name=order.user.name,
            products=[item.product.name for item in order.items],
            total=float(order.total),
        )
        for order in orders
    ]

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, selectinload

from app.db import get_db
from app.models import Order, OrderItem, Product

router = APIRouter()


class ReserveRequest(BaseModel):
    quantity: int = Field(gt=0)


class ReserveResponse(BaseModel):
    product_id: int
    quantity_reserved: int
    remaining_stock: int


class RestockItem(BaseModel):
    product_id: int
    quantity: int = Field(gt=0)


class RestockResult(BaseModel):
    product_id: int
    stock: int


class SalesReportItem(BaseModel):
    order_id: int
    created_at: datetime
    customer_name: str
    product_names: list[str]
    total: float


@router.post("/products/{product_id}/reserve", response_model=ReserveResponse)
def reserve_product(product_id: int, body: ReserveRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> ReserveResponse:
    product = db.get(Product, product_id)
    if product is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="product not found")
    if product.stock < body.quantity:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="insufficient stock")

    product.stock -= body.quantity
    db.commit()
    return ReserveResponse(
        product_id=product.id,
        quantity_reserved=body.quantity,
        remaining_stock=product.stock,
    )


@router.post("/products/restock", response_model=list[RestockResult])
def restock_products(items: list[RestockItem], db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> list[RestockResult]:
    products = []
    for item in items:
        product = db.get(Product, item.product_id)
        if product is None:
            db.rollback()
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"product {item.product_id} not found")
        product.stock += item.quantity
        products.append(product)

    db.commit()
    return [RestockResult(product_id=product.id, stock=product.stock) for product in products]


@router.get("/reports/sales", response_model=list[SalesReportItem])
def sales_report(db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> list[SalesReportItem]:
    cutoff = (datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(days=30)).replace(tzinfo=None)
    orders = (
        db.execute(
            select(Order)
            .where(Order.created_at >= cutoff)
            .options(selectinload(Order.user), selectinload(Order.items).selectinload(OrderItem.product))
            .order_by(Order.created_at.desc())
        )
        .scalars()
        .all()
    )
    return [
        SalesReportItem(
            order_id=order.id,
            created_at=order.created_at,
            customer_name=order.user.name,
            product_names=[item.product.name for item in order.items],
            total=float(order.total),
        )
        for order in orders
    ]

import asyncio
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from app.trials import (
    REMINDER_WINDOW_DAYS,
    TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS,
    ReminderWorker,
    TrialUser,
    days_left,
    generate_discount_code,
    generate_discount_codes,
    is_trial_expired,
    trial_end_date,
    users_expiring_soon,
)


def user(email: str, days_ago: float, now: datetime) -> TrialUser:
    return TrialUser(email=email, signup_at=now - timedelta(days=days_ago))


# --- trial_end_date -----------------------------------------------------


def test_trial_end_date_adds_trial_length():
    signup = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
    assert trial_end_date(signup) == signup + timedelta(days=TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS)


def test_trial_end_date_supports_custom_length():
    signup = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
    assert trial_end_date(signup, trial_days=30) == signup + timedelta(days=30)


def test_trial_end_date_treats_naive_signup_as_utc():
    naive_signup = datetime(2026, 1, 1)
    aware_signup = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
    assert trial_end_date(naive_signup) == trial_end_date(aware_signup)


# --- days_left ------------------------------------------------------------


def test_days_left_full_trial_on_signup_day():
    signup = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
    assert days_left(signup, now=signup) == TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS


def test_days_left_decreases_as_time_passes():
    signup = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
    now = signup + timedelta(days=5)
    assert days_left(signup, now=now) == TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS - 5


def test_days_left_rounds_partial_day_up():
    signup = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
    now = trial_end_date(signup) - timedelta(seconds=1)
    assert days_left(signup, now=now) == 1


def test_days_left_is_zero_exactly_at_expiry():
    signup = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
    now = trial_end_date(signup)
    assert days_left(signup, now=now) == 0


def test_days_left_is_zero_and_not_negative_after_expiry():
    signup = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
    now = trial_end_date(signup) + timedelta(days=100)
    assert days_left(signup, now=now) == 0


def test_days_left_accepts_naive_now():
    signup = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
    now_naive = datetime(2026, 1, 3)
    assert days_left(signup, now=now_naive) == TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS - 2


# --- is_trial_expired -------------------------------------------------


def test_is_trial_expired_false_during_trial():
    signup = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
    now = signup + timedelta(days=1)
    assert is_trial_expired(signup, now=now) is False


def test_is_trial_expired_true_after_end():
    signup = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
    now = trial_end_date(signup) + timedelta(seconds=1)
    assert is_trial_expired(signup, now=now) is True


def test_is_trial_expired_true_exactly_at_end():
    signup = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
    now = trial_end_date(signup)
    assert is_trial_expired(signup, now=now) is True


# --- users_expiring_soon -----------------------------------------------


def test_users_expiring_soon_selects_correct_window():
    now = datetime(2026, 1, 15, tzinfo=UTC)
    already_expired = user("expired@example.com", days_ago=TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS + 1, now=now)
    ends_in_one_day = user("soon1@example.com", days_ago=TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS - 1, now=now)
    ends_in_three_days = user("soon3@example.com", days_ago=TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS - REMINDER_WINDOW_DAYS, now=now)
    ends_in_four_days = user("later@example.com", days_ago=TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS - 4, now=now)
    brand_new = user("new@example.com", days_ago=0, now=now)

    result = users_expiring_soon(
        [already_expired, ends_in_one_day, ends_in_three_days, ends_in_four_days, brand_new],
        now=now,
    )

    emails = {u.email for u in result}
    assert emails == {"soon1@example.com", "soon3@example.com"}


def test_users_expiring_soon_empty_list():
    assert users_expiring_soon([], now=datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)) == []


def test_users_expiring_soon_respects_custom_window():
    now = datetime(2026, 1, 15, tzinfo=UTC)
    ends_in_five_days = user("five@example.com", days_ago=TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS - 5, now=now)

    assert users_expiring_soon([ends_in_five_days], now=now, within_days=3) == []
    assert users_expiring_soon([ends_in_five_days], now=now, within_days=5) == [ends_in_five_days]


# --- discount codes -------------------------------------------------------


def test_generate_discount_code_has_expected_shape():
    u = TrialUser(email="a@example.com", signup_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC))
    code = generate_discount_code(u)
    assert code.startswith("TRIAL-")
    assert len(code) == len("TRIAL-") + 16


def test_generate_discount_code_is_unique_across_calls():
    u = TrialUser(email="a@example.com", signup_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC))
    codes = {generate_discount_code(u) for _ in range(50)}
    assert len(codes) == 50


def test_generate_discount_codes_maps_every_user():
    now = datetime(2026, 1, 15, tzinfo=UTC)
    users = [user(f"user{i}@example.com", days_ago=13, now=now) for i in range(20)]
    codes = generate_discount_codes(users)

    assert set(codes.keys()) == {u.email for u in users}
    assert len(set(codes.values())) == len(users)
    assert all(code.startswith("TRIAL-") for code in codes.values())


def test_generate_discount_codes_empty_input():
    assert generate_discount_codes([]) == {}


# --- ReminderWorker --------------------------------------------------------


def run(coro):
    return asyncio.run(coro)


def test_reminder_worker_run_once_notifies_only_expiring_users():
    now = datetime(2026, 1, 15, tzinfo=UTC)
    expiring = user("expiring@example.com", days_ago=13, now=now)
    safe = user("safe@example.com", days_ago=1, now=now)
    sent: list[tuple[str, str]] = []

    def get_users():
        return [expiring, safe]

    def send_email(u: TrialUser, code: str):
        sent.append((u.email, code))

    worker = ReminderWorker(get_users, send_email, clock=lambda: now)
    notified = run(worker.run_once())

    assert [u.email for u in notified] == ["expiring@example.com"]
    assert len(sent) == 1
    assert sent[0][0] == "expiring@example.com"
    assert sent[0][1].startswith("TRIAL-")
    assert worker.notified_emails == {"expiring@example.com"}


def test_reminder_worker_does_not_renotify_same_user():
    now = datetime(2026, 1, 15, tzinfo=UTC)
    expiring = user("expiring@example.com", days_ago=13, now=now)
    sent: list[str] = []

    worker = ReminderWorker(
        get_users=lambda: [expiring],
        send_email=lambda u, code: sent.append(u.email),
        clock=lambda: now,
    )

    run(worker.run_once())
    run(worker.run_once())

    assert sent == ["expiring@example.com"]


def test_reminder_worker_supports_async_get_users_and_send_email():
    now = datetime(2026, 1, 15, tzinfo=UTC)
    expiring = user("expiring@example.com", days_ago=13, now=now)
    sent: list[str] = []

    async def get_users():
        return [expiring]

    async def send_email(u: TrialUser, code: str):
        sent.append(u.email)

    worker = ReminderWorker(get_users, send_email, clock=lambda: now)
    run(worker.run_once())

    assert sent == ["expiring@example.com"]


def test_reminder_worker_iteration_error_does_not_crash_loop(caplog):
    now = datetime(2026, 1, 15, tzinfo=UTC)

    def get_users():
        raise RuntimeError("boom")

    worker = ReminderWorker(get_users, send_email=lambda u, c: None, clock=lambda: now, interval_seconds=0.02)

    async def scenario():
        worker.start()
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        await worker.stop()

    run(scenario())
    assert "Reminder worker iteration failed" in caplog.text


def test_reminder_worker_start_runs_periodically_and_stop_ends_it():
    now = datetime(2026, 1, 15, tzinfo=UTC)
    expiring = user("expiring@example.com", days_ago=13, now=now)
    call_count = 0

    def get_users():
        nonlocal call_count
        call_count += 1
        return [expiring]

    worker = ReminderWorker(
        get_users,
        send_email=lambda u, code: None,
        clock=lambda: now,
        interval_seconds=0.02,
    )

    async def scenario():
        worker.start()
        await asyncio.sleep(0.09)
        await worker.stop()

    run(scenario())

    assert call_count >= 3
    assert worker.notified_emails == {"expiring@example.com"}


def test_reminder_worker_start_is_idempotent_while_running():
    now = datetime(2026, 1, 15, tzinfo=UTC)
    worker = ReminderWorker(get_users=lambda: [], send_email=lambda u, c: None, clock=lambda: now)

    async def scenario():
        worker.start()
        first_task = worker._task
        worker.start()
        second_task = worker._task
        await worker.stop()
        return first_task is second_task

    assert run(scenario()) is True


def test_reminder_worker_stop_before_start_is_safe():
    worker = ReminderWorker(get_users=lambda: [], send_email=lambda u, c: None)
    run(worker.stop())

class ProjectsController < ApplicationController
  def index
    scope = current_user.projects
    scope = scope.where("name LIKE ?", "%#{params[:q]}%") if params[:q].present?
    render json: scope.order(sort_order)
  end

  def show
    render json: project
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
    head :not_found
  end

  def create
    project = current_user.projects.build(project_params)
    if project.save
      render json: project, status: :created
    else
      render json: { errors: project.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_content
    end
  end

  def update
    if project.update(project_params)
      render json: project
    else
      render json: { errors: project.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_content
    end
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
    head :not_found
  end

  def destroy
    project.destroy
    head :no_content
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
    head :not_found
  end

  private

  def project
    @project ||= current_user.projects.find(params[:id])
  end

  def project_params
    params.require(:project).permit(:name, :description, :status, :featured)
  end

  def sort_order
    column = params[:sort].to_s
    Project.column_names.include?(column) ? column : { created_at: :desc }
  end

import asyncio
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

import pytest

from app import trials
from app.trials import (
    TRIAL_DAYS,
    ReminderWorker,
    TrialUser,
    days_left,
    generate_discount_code,
    generate_discount_codes,
    is_expired,
    users_ending_soon,
)

NOW = datetime(2026, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=UTC)


def user(id: int, days_ago: float, email: str | None = None) -> TrialUser:
    return TrialUser(id=id, email=email or f"user{id}@example.com", signup_at=NOW - timedelta(days=days_ago))


# --- days_left --------------------------------------------------------------


def test_days_left_at_signup_is_full_trial():
    assert days_left(NOW, now=NOW) == TRIAL_DAYS


def test_days_left_counts_down():
    signup = NOW - timedelta(days=5)
    assert days_left(signup, now=NOW) == TRIAL_DAYS - 5


def test_days_left_rounds_up_partial_days():
    # 13 days and 1 hour have elapsed: under a day remains, which still counts as 1.
    signup = NOW - timedelta(days=13, hours=1)
    assert days_left(signup, now=NOW) == 1


def test_days_left_is_zero_exactly_at_expiry():
    signup = NOW - timedelta(days=TRIAL_DAYS)
    assert days_left(signup, now=NOW) == 0


def test_days_left_never_negative_after_expiry():
    signup = NOW - timedelta(days=TRIAL_DAYS + 30)
    assert days_left(signup, now=NOW) == 0


def test_days_left_defaults_to_current_time(monkeypatch):
    fixed = NOW

    class _FrozenDatetime(datetime):
        @classmethod
        def now(cls, tz=None):
            return fixed if tz is None else fixed.astimezone(tz)

    monkeypatch.setattr(trials, "datetime", _FrozenDatetime)
    signup = fixed - timedelta(days=1)
    assert days_left(signup) == TRIAL_DAYS - 1


def test_days_left_treats_naive_datetimes_as_utc():
    naive_signup = NOW.replace(tzinfo=None) - timedelta(days=2)
    assert days_left(naive_signup, now=NOW) == TRIAL_DAYS - 2


# --- is_expired ---------------------------------------------------------


def test_is_expired_false_while_in_trial():
    signup = NOW - timedelta(days=TRIAL_DAYS - 1)
    assert is_expired(signup, now=NOW) is False


def test_is_expired_true_exactly_at_boundary():
    signup = NOW - timedelta(days=TRIAL_DAYS)
    assert is_expired(signup, now=NOW) is True


def test_is_expired_true_after_boundary():
    signup = NOW - timedelta(days=TRIAL_DAYS + 1)
    assert is_expired(signup, now=NOW) is True


# --- users_ending_soon ----------------------------------------------------


def test_users_ending_soon_filters_by_window():
    fresh = user(1, days_ago=1)  # 13 days left, not in window
    ending_soon = user(2, days_ago=12)  # 2 days left
    ending_today = user(3, days_ago=13, )  # ~1 day left
    already_expired = user(4, days_ago=TRIAL_DAYS + 2)
    just_signed_up = user(5, days_ago=0)

    result = users_ending_soon([fresh, ending_soon, ending_today, already_expired, just_signed_up], now=NOW)

    assert {u.id for u in result} == {2, 3}


def test_users_ending_soon_respects_custom_window():
    borderline = user(1, days_ago=10)  # 4 days left
    result = users_ending_soon([borderline], now=NOW, within_days=3)
    assert result == []
    result = users_ending_soon([borderline], now=NOW, within_days=4)
    assert result == [borderline]


def test_users_ending_soon_excludes_expired_users():
    expired = user(1, days_ago=TRIAL_DAYS)
    assert users_ending_soon([expired], now=NOW) == []


def test_users_ending_soon_empty_input():
    assert users_ending_soon([], now=NOW) == []


# --- discount codes -------------------------------------------------------


def test_generate_discount_code_contains_user_id_and_prefix():
    u = user(42, days_ago=13)
    code = generate_discount_code(u)
    assert code.startswith("TRIAL-42-")


def test_generate_discount_code_is_random_each_call():
    u = user(1, days_ago=13)
    assert generate_discount_code(u) != generate_discount_code(u)


def test_generate_discount_codes_unique_across_many_users():
    users = [user(i, days_ago=13) for i in range(200)]
    codes = generate_discount_codes(users)
    assert len(codes) == len(users)
    assert len(set(codes.values())) == len(users)


def test_generate_discount_codes_maps_each_user_id():
    users = [user(1, days_ago=13), user(2, days_ago=13)]
    codes = generate_discount_codes(users)
    assert set(codes.keys()) == {1, 2}


def test_generate_discount_codes_retries_on_collision(monkeypatch):
    calls = iter(["deadbeef00", "deadbeef00", "cafef00d99"])

    def fake_token_hex(_n: int) -> str:
        return next(calls)

    monkeypatch.setattr(trials.secrets, "token_hex", fake_token_hex)

    users = [user(1, days_ago=13), user(2, days_ago=13)]
    codes = generate_discount_codes(users)

    assert len(set(codes.values())) == 2


# --- ReminderWorker ---------------------------------------------------------


class FakeMailer:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.sent: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []
        self.event = asyncio.Event()

    def __call__(self, to: str, subject: str, body: str) -> None:
        self.sent.append((to, subject, body))
        self.event.set()


def test_run_once_emails_only_expiring_users():
    mailer = FakeMailer()
    users = [user(1, days_ago=1), user(2, days_ago=12), user(3, days_ago=TRIAL_DAYS + 1)]
    worker = ReminderWorker(lambda: users, send_email=mailer, clock=lambda: NOW)

    codes = asyncio.run(worker.run_once())

    assert set(codes.keys()) == {2}
    assert len(mailer.sent) == 1
    to, subject, body = mailer.sent[0]
    assert to == "user2@example.com"
    assert codes[2] in body


def test_run_once_returns_empty_when_nobody_expiring():
    mailer = FakeMailer()
    users = [user(1, days_ago=1)]
    worker = ReminderWorker(lambda: users, send_email=mailer, clock=lambda: NOW)

    codes = asyncio.run(worker.run_once())

    assert codes == {}
    assert mailer.sent == []


def test_run_once_supports_async_get_users():
    mailer = FakeMailer()
    users = [user(2, days_ago=12)]

    async def get_users():
        return users

    worker = ReminderWorker(get_users, send_email=mailer, clock=lambda: NOW)
    codes = asyncio.run(worker.run_once())

    assert set(codes.keys()) == {2}
    assert len(mailer.sent) == 1


def test_run_once_continues_on_send_email_error():
    users = [user(2, days_ago=12), user(3, days_ago=13)]

    def flaky_mailer(to: str, subject: str, body: str) -> None:
        if to == "user2@example.com":
            raise RuntimeError("smtp down")

    worker = ReminderWorker(lambda: users, send_email=flaky_mailer, clock=lambda: NOW)

    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        asyncio.run(worker.run_once())


def test_worker_start_stop_runs_multiple_iterations():
    mailer = FakeMailer()
    users = [user(2, days_ago=12)]
    worker = ReminderWorker(lambda: users, send_email=mailer, clock=lambda: NOW, interval_seconds=0.02)

    async def scenario():
        await worker.start()
        assert worker.running is True
        for _ in range(3):
            await asyncio.wait_for(mailer.event.wait(), timeout=1)
            mailer.event.clear()
        await worker.stop()
        assert worker.running is False

    asyncio.run(scenario())

    assert len(mailer.sent) >= 3


def test_worker_stop_is_idempotent_and_start_is_reentrant():
    mailer = FakeMailer()
    worker = ReminderWorker(lambda: [], send_email=mailer, clock=lambda: NOW, interval_seconds=0.05)

    async def scenario():
        await worker.start()
        first_task = worker._task
        await worker.start()  # no-op while already running
        assert worker._task is first_task
        await worker.stop()
        await worker.stop()  # no-op once stopped

    asyncio.run(scenario())
    assert worker.running is False


def test_worker_uses_default_interval_and_trial_days():
    worker = ReminderWorker(lambda: [])
    assert worker._interval_seconds == trials.DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS
    assert worker._trial_days == TRIAL_DAYS
    assert worker._within_days == trials.REMINDER_WINDOW_DAYS

import asyncio
import os
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from typing import Any

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.auth import get_current_user
from app.db import get_db
from app.models import Order, User

router = APIRouter()

PROFILE_URL = os.environ.get("PROFILE_URL", "http://profile-service")
NOTIFY_URL = os.environ.get("NOTIFY_URL", "http://notify-service")
PRICES_URL = os.environ.get("PRICES_URL", "http://prices-service")


async def get_http_client() -> AsyncIterator[httpx.AsyncClient]:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        yield client


async def _fetch_or_none(client: httpx.AsyncClient, url: str) -> Any | None:
    try:
        response = await client.get(url, timeout=5.0)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.json()
    except httpx.HTTPError:
        return None


async def _fetch_or_raise(client: httpx.AsyncClient, url: str) -> Any:
    response = await client.get(url, timeout=5.0)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()


async def _fetch_prices(client: httpx.AsyncClient, tickers: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    if not tickers:
        return {}
    try:
        quotes = await asyncio.gather(
            *(_fetch_or_raise(client, f"{PRICES_URL}/quote/{ticker}") for ticker in tickers)
        )
    except httpx.HTTPError:
        return None
    return dict(zip(tickers, quotes, strict=True))


def _serialize_order(order: Order) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": order.id,
        "status": order.status,
        "total": float(order.total),
        "created_at": order.created_at.isoformat() if order.created_at else None,
    }


@router.get("/dashboard")
async def get_dashboard(
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    client: httpx.AsyncClient = Depends(get_http_client),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    recent_orders = (
        db.execute(select(Order).where(Order.user_id == user.id).order_by(Order.created_at.desc()).limit(5))
        .scalars()
        .all()
    )

    profile, notifications = await asyncio.gather(
        _fetch_or_none(client, f"{PROFILE_URL}/users/{user.id}"),
        _fetch_or_none(client, f"{NOTIFY_URL}/users/{user.id}/notifications/unread"),
    )

    watchlist = profile.get("watchlist", []) if profile is not None else []
    prices = await _fetch_prices(client, watchlist) if profile is not None else None

    return {
        "profile": profile,
        "notifications": notifications,
        "prices": prices,
        "orders": [_serialize_order(order) for order in recent_orders],
    }

class ProjectsController < ApplicationController
  def index
    projects = current_user.projects

    if params[:q].present?
      projects = projects.where("name LIKE ?", "%#{params[:q]}%")
    end

    if params[:sort].present? && Project.column_names.include?(params[:sort].to_s)
      projects = projects.order(params[:sort].to_s => :asc)
    else
      projects = projects.order(created_at: :desc)
    end

    render json: projects
  end

  def show
    project = find_project
    return unless project

    render json: project
  end

  def create
    project = current_user.projects.build(project_params)

    if project.save
      render json: project, status: :created
    else
      render json: { errors: project.errors }, status: :unprocessable_content
    end
  end

  def update
    project = find_project
    return unless project

    if project.update(project_params)
      render json: project
    else
      render json: { errors: project.errors }, status: :unprocessable_content
    end
  end

  def destroy
    project = find_project
    return unless project

    project.destroy
    head :no_content
  end

  private

  def find_project
    current_user.projects.find(params[:id])
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
    render json: { errors: ["Project not found"] }, status: :not_found
    nil
  end

  def project_params
    params.require(:project).permit(:name, :description, :status, :featured)
  end

# Places an order for a user: creates the order and line items, decrements
# stock, charges the card, emails a confirmation, and enqueues fulfillment.
class Checkout
  class OutOfStockError < StandardError
    attr_reader :product

    def initialize(product)
      @product = product
      super("#{product.name} is out of stock")
    end
  end

  def initialize(user, cart_items, card_token)
    @user = user
    @cart_items = cart_items
    @card_token = card_token
  end

  def call
    order = nil

    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction(requires_new: true) do
      order = Order.create!(user: @user, status: "pending", total_cents: 0)
      total_cents = 0

      @cart_items.each do |item|
        product = Product.find(item.fetch(:product_id))
        quantity = item.fetch(:quantity)

        raise OutOfStockError, product if product.stock < quantity

        product.update!(stock: product.stock - quantity)

        order.line_items.create!(
          product: product,
          quantity: quantity,
          unit_price_cents: product.price_cents
        )

        total_cents += product.price_cents * quantity
      end

      charge_id = PaymentGateway.charge(amount_cents: total_cents, token: @card_token)
      order.update!(status: "paid", total_cents: total_cents, charge_id: charge_id)

      OrderMailer.confirmation(order).deliver_now
      FulfillmentJob.perform_later(order.id)
    end

    order
  end
end

# Sales for a date range, one row per order.
class SalesReport
  Row = Struct.new(:order_id, :customer_name, :product_names, :total_cents, keyword_init: true)

  def self.call(range)
    new(range).call
  end

  def initialize(range)
    @range = range
  end

  def call
    Order.where(created_at: @range)
         .includes(:user, line_items: :product)
         .order(:created_at, :id)
         .map { |order| to_row(order) }
  end

  private

  def to_row(order)
    Row.new(
      order_id: order.id,
      customer_name: order.user.name,
      product_names: order.line_items.map { |line_item| line_item.product.name },
      total_cents: order.total_cents
    )
  end
end

class InvitationsController < ApplicationController
  def create
    project = Project.find_by(id: params[:project_id])
    return head :not_found unless project
    return head :forbidden unless current_user && project.user_id == current_user.id

    invitation = project.invitations.new(email: params[:email])

    if invitation.save
      InvitationMailer.invite(invitation).deliver_now
      render json: { id: invitation.id, email: invitation.email, expires_at: invitation.expires_at }, status: :created
    else
      render json: { errors: invitation.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_content
    end
  end

  def accept
    invitation = Invitation.find_by(token: params[:token])
    return head :not_found unless invitation
    return render(json: { error: "This invitation has expired" }, status: :gone) if invitation.expired?

    invitation.accept! unless invitation.accepted?

    redirect_to(safe_return_to || "/projects")
  end

  private

  # Only allow redirecting to a path on our own site, never to an external host.
  def safe_return_to
    return_to = params[:return_to]
    return unless return_to.is_a?(String)
    return unless return_to.start_with?("/")
    return if return_to.start_with?("//") || return_to.start_with?("/\\")

    return_to
  end
end

  before_validation :assign_expiration, on: :create

  end
end

class InvitationsController < ApplicationController
  def create
    project = Project.find_by(id: params[:project_id])
    return head :not_found unless project
    return head :forbidden unless current_user && project.user_id == current_user.id

    invitation = project.invitations.new(email: params[:email])

    if invitation.save
      InvitationMailer.invite(invitation).deliver_now
      render json: { id: invitation.id, email: invitation.email, token: invitation.token }, status: :created
    else
      render json: { errors: invitation.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_content
    end
  end

  def accept
    invitation = Invitation.find_by(token: params[:token])
    return head :not_found unless invitation
    return render json: { error: "Invitation has expired" }, status: :unprocessable_content if invitation.expired?

    invitation.update!(accepted_at: Time.current)

    redirect_to safe_return_path
  end

  private

  # A single leading "/" not followed by another "/" or "\" (which browsers
  # normalize to "//") and with no whitespace rules out scheme-relative and
  # protocol URLs (e.g. "//evil.com", "/\evil.com", "https://evil.com").
  SAFE_PATH = %r{\A/(?![/\\])\S*\z}

  def safe_return_path
    candidate = params[:return_to].to_s
    SAFE_PATH.match?(candidate) ? candidate : "/projects"
  end
end

import hashlib
import sys


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    if len(argv) != 3:
        print("usage: stamp.py <input manifest> <output manifest>", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    src, dst = argv[1], argv[2]
    with open(src, "rb") as f:
        content = f.read()

    checksum = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
    with open(dst, "wb") as f:
        f.write(f"# checksum: {checksum}\n".encode("utf-8"))
        f.write(content)

from app.auth import get_current_user

router = APIRouter(prefix="/orders", tags=["orders"])


def _serialize_order(order: Order) -> dict[str, object]:
    return {
        "id": order.id,
        "status": order.status,
        "total": float(order.total),
        "payment_id": order.payment_id,
        "created_at": order.created_at.isoformat() if order.created_at else None,
        "items": [
            {"id": item.id, "product_id": item.product_id, "quantity": item.quantity}
            for item in order.items
        ],
    }


def _get_owned_order(order_id: int, user: User, db: Session) -> Order:
    order = db.query(Order).options(joinedload(Order.items)).filter(Order.id == order_id).first()
    if order is None or order.user_id != user.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="order not found")
    return order


@router.get("/{order_id}")
async def get_order(
    order_id: int,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
) -> dict[str, object]:
    order = _get_owned_order(order_id, user, db)
    return _serialize_order(order)


@router.post("/{order_id}/refund")
async def refund_order(
    order_id: int,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    payments_client: PaymentsClient = Depends(get_payments_client),
) -> dict[str, object]:
    order = _get_owned_order(order_id, user, db)

    if order.status == "refunded":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="order already refunded")

    refund = await run_in_threadpool(payments_client.refund, order.payment_id, float(order.total))

    order.status = "refunded"
    db.add(order)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(order)

    await run_in_threadpool(
        send_email,
        user.email,
        f"Refund confirmation for order #{order.id}",
        f"Your refund of ${float(order.total):.2f} for order #{order.id} has been processed "
        f"(refund id: {refund.id}).",
    )

    return {**_serialize_order(order), "refund_id": refund.id}

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlalchemy import bindparam, select, update
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.db import get_db
from app.models import Order, Product

router = APIRouter()


class ReserveRequest(BaseModel):
    quantity: int = Field(gt=0)


class ProductStock(BaseModel):
    product_id: int
    stock: int


class RestockItem(BaseModel):
    product_id: int
    quantity: int = Field(gt=0)


class SalesReportEntry(BaseModel):
    order_id: int
    created_at: datetime
    customer_name: str
    products: list[str]


@router.post("/products/{product_id}/reserve", response_model=ProductStock)
def reserve_product(product_id: int, body: ReserveRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> ProductStock:
    product = db.get(Product, product_id)
    if product is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="product not found")

    # Atomic conditional update avoids a read-then-write race between the stock
    # check and the decrement under concurrent requests.
    result = db.execute(
        update(Product)
        .where(Product.id == product_id, Product.stock >= body.quantity)
        .values(stock=Product.stock - body.quantity)
    )
    if result.rowcount == 0:
        db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="not enough stock")

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(product)
    return ProductStock(product_id=product.id, stock=product.stock)


@router.post("/products/restock", response_model=list[ProductStock])
def restock_products(items: list[RestockItem], db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> list[ProductStock]:
    ids = [item.product_id for item in items]
    existing_ids = set(db.scalars(select(Product.id).where(Product.id.in_(ids))).all())
    missing_ids = set(ids) - existing_ids
    if missing_ids:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"products not found: {sorted(missing_ids)}")

    # Use the Core connection directly (rather than Session.execute) so this
    # executemany-style bulk UPDATE isn't routed through the ORM's bulk-update
    # machinery, which requires primary keys to be supplied per WHERE clause.
    db.connection().execute(
        update(Product).where(Product.id == bindparam("pid")).values(stock=Product.stock + bindparam("qty")),
        [{"pid": item.product_id, "qty": item.quantity} for item in items],
    )
    db.commit()
    # The raw-connection UPDATE bypassed the session's identity map, so any of
    # these products already loaded in-session would otherwise read back stale.
    db.expire_all()

    products = db.scalars(select(Product).where(Product.id.in_(ids))).all()
    return [ProductStock(product_id=product.id, stock=product.stock) for product in products]


@router.get("/reports/sales", response_model=list[SalesReportEntry])
def sales_report(db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> list[SalesReportEntry]:
    cutoff = datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=30)
    orders = db.scalars(
        select(Order).where(Order.created_at >= cutoff).order_by(Order.created_at.desc())
    ).all()
    return [
        SalesReportEntry(
            order_id=order.id,
            created_at=order.created_at,
            customer_name=order.user.name,
            products=[item.product.name for item in order.items],
        )
        for order in orders
    ]

"""Free-trial expiry tracking, discount codes, and reminder emails."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import math
import secrets
from collections.abc import Callable, Iterable
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from app.models import User
from app.notifications import send_email

TRIAL_DAYS = 14
REMINDER_WINDOW_DAYS = 3


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _as_utc(dt: datetime) -> datetime:
    if dt.tzinfo is None:
        return dt.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
    return dt.astimezone(UTC)


def trial_end_at(signup_at: datetime, trial_days: int = TRIAL_DAYS) -> datetime:
    """The instant a trial started at `signup_at` ends."""
    return _as_utc(signup_at) + timedelta(days=trial_days)


def days_left(signup_at: datetime, now: datetime | None = None, trial_days: int = TRIAL_DAYS) -> int:
    """Whole days remaining in the trial, rounded up. 0 once the trial has expired."""
    now = _as_utc(now) if now is not None else _utcnow()
    remaining = trial_end_at(signup_at, trial_days) - now
    if remaining <= timedelta(0):
        return 0
    return max(1, math.ceil(remaining.total_seconds() / 86400))


def is_trial_expired(signup_at: datetime, now: datetime | None = None, trial_days: int = TRIAL_DAYS) -> bool:
    now = _as_utc(now) if now is not None else _utcnow()
    return now >= trial_end_at(signup_at, trial_days)


def users_expiring_soon(
    users: Iterable[User],
    now: datetime | None = None,
    within_days: int = REMINDER_WINDOW_DAYS,
    trial_days: int = TRIAL_DAYS,
) -> list[User]:
    """Users whose (unexpired) trial ends within `within_days` days of `now`."""
    now = _as_utc(now) if now is not None else _utcnow()
    return [
        user
        for user in users
        if not is_trial_expired(user.created_at, now=now, trial_days=trial_days)
        and days_left(user.created_at, now=now, trial_days=trial_days) <= within_days
    ]


def generate_discount_code(user: User) -> str:
    """A random, unique-per-call discount code tied to the user's id."""
    token = secrets.token_hex(4).upper()
    return f"TRIAL{user.id}-{token}"


def generate_discount_codes(users: Iterable[User]) -> dict[int, str]:
    """Map of user id -> discount code for every user passed in."""
    return {user.id: generate_discount_code(user) for user in users}


class ReminderWorker:
    """Periodically emails users whose trial is about to expire with a discount code."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        get_users: Callable[[], Iterable[User]],
        *,
        interval_seconds: float = 3600,
        trial_days: int = TRIAL_DAYS,
        within_days: int = REMINDER_WINDOW_DAYS,
        send_email: Callable[[str, str, str], None] = send_email,
        clock: Callable[[], datetime] = _utcnow,
    ) -> None:
        self._get_users = get_users
        self.interval_seconds = interval_seconds
        self.trial_days = trial_days
        self.within_days = within_days
        self._send_email = send_email
        self._clock = clock
        self._task: asyncio.Task[None] | None = None
        self._stop_event: asyncio.Event | None = None

    @property
    def running(self) -> bool:
        return self._task is not None and not self._task.done()

    def start(self) -> None:
        if self.running:
            return
        self._stop_event = asyncio.Event()
        self._task = asyncio.create_task(self._loop())

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        if self._task is None:
            return
        stop_event = self._stop_event
        assert stop_event is not None
        stop_event.set()
        await self._task
        self._task = None
        self._stop_event = None

    async def _loop(self) -> None:
        stop_event = self._stop_event
        assert stop_event is not None
        while not stop_event.is_set():
            await self.run_once()
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(stop_event.wait(), timeout=self.interval_seconds)
            except TimeoutError:
                pass

    async def run_once(self) -> list[str]:
        """Email every currently-expiring user once, returning the codes sent."""
        now = self._clock()
        users = list(self._get_users())
        expiring = users_expiring_soon(users, now=now, within_days=self.within_days, trial_days=self.trial_days)
        codes = generate_discount_codes(expiring)
        sent: list[str] = []
        for user in expiring:
            code = codes[user.id]
            remaining = days_left(user.created_at, now=now, trial_days=self.trial_days)
            body = (
                f"Hi {user.name}, your free trial ends in {remaining} day(s). "
                f"Use code {code} for a discount if you upgrade now."
            )
            await asyncio.to_thread(self._send_email, user.email, "Your trial is ending soon", body)
            sent.append(code)
        return sent

class ProjectsController < ApplicationController
  def index
    scope = current_user.projects
    scope = scope.where("name LIKE ?", "%#{params[:q]}%") if params[:q].present?
    render json: apply_sort(scope)
  end

  def show
    project = find_project
    return unless project

    render json: project
  end

  def create
    project = current_user.projects.build(project_params)

    if project.save
      render json: project, status: :created
    else
      render json: { errors: project.errors }, status: :unprocessable_content
    end
  end

  def update
    project = find_project
    return unless project

    if project.update(project_params)
      render json: project
    else
      render json: { errors: project.errors }, status: :unprocessable_content
    end
  end

  def destroy
    project = find_project
    return unless project

    project.destroy
    head :no_content
  end

  private

  def find_project
    project = current_user.projects.find_by(id: params[:id])
    render json: { error: "Project not found" }, status: :not_found unless project
    project
  end

  def project_params
    params.require(:project).permit(:name, :description, :status, :featured)
  end

  def apply_sort(scope)
    sort_param = params[:sort].to_s
    column = sort_param.sub(/\A-/, "")
    direction = sort_param.start_with?("-") ? :desc : :asc

    if column.present? && Project.column_names.include?(column)
      scope.order(column => direction)
    else
      scope.order(created_at: :desc)
    end
  end
end

import logging
import math
import secrets

from app.notifications import send_email

TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS = 14
EXPIRING_SOON_WINDOW_DAYS = 3

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

EmailSender = Callable[[str, str, str], None]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TrialUser:
    id: int
    email: str
    signup_at: datetime


def trial_end_date(signup_at: datetime, trial_days: int = TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS) -> datetime:
    return signup_at + timedelta(days=trial_days)


def days_left(signup_at: datetime, *, now: datetime | None = None, trial_days: int = TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS) -> int:
    now = now or datetime.now()
    remaining_seconds = (trial_end_date(signup_at, trial_days) - now).total_seconds()
    return max(0, math.ceil(remaining_seconds / 86400))


def is_trial_expired(signup_at: datetime, *, now: datetime | None = None, trial_days: int = TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS) -> bool:
    now = now or datetime.now()
    return now >= trial_end_date(signup_at, trial_days)


def users_expiring_soon(
    users: Iterable[TrialUser],
    *,
    now: datetime | None = None,
    trial_days: int = TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS,
    window_days: int = EXPIRING_SOON_WINDOW_DAYS,
) -> list[TrialUser]:
    now = now or datetime.now()
    return [
        user
        for user in users
        if not is_trial_expired(user.signup_at, now=now, trial_days=trial_days)
        and days_left(user.signup_at, now=now, trial_days=trial_days) <= window_days
    ]


def generate_discount_code(user: TrialUser, *, prefix: str = "TRIAL", token_length: int = 8) -> str:
    token = secrets.token_hex(token_length)[:token_length].upper()
    return f"{prefix}-{user.id}-{token}"


def generate_discount_codes(users: Iterable[TrialUser]) -> dict[int, str]:
    return {user.id: generate_discount_code(user) for user in users}


class ReminderWorker:
    """Periodically emails users whose trial is about to expire, with a one-time discount code."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        get_users: Callable[[], Iterable[TrialUser]],
        *,
        interval_seconds: float = 3600,
        trial_days: int = TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS,
        window_days: int = EXPIRING_SOON_WINDOW_DAYS,
        send_email: EmailSender = send_email,
        clock: Callable[[], datetime] = datetime.now,
    ) -> None:
        self._get_users = get_users
        self._interval_seconds = interval_seconds
        self._trial_days = trial_days
        self._window_days = window_days
        self._send_email = send_email
        self._clock = clock
        self._task: asyncio.Task | None = None
        self.notified: set[int] = set()

    async def run_once(self) -> dict[int, str]:
        """Email every not-yet-notified expiring user once, returning their discount codes."""
        now = self._clock()
        expiring = users_expiring_soon(
            self._get_users(), now=now, trial_days=self._trial_days, window_days=self._window_days
        )
        to_notify = [user for user in expiring if user.id not in self.notified]
        all_codes = generate_discount_codes(to_notify)
        sent_codes: dict[int, str] = {}
        for user in to_notify:
            remaining = days_left(user.signup_at, now=now, trial_days=self._trial_days)
            code = all_codes[user.id]
            body = (
                f"Hi {user.email}, your free trial ends in {remaining} day(s). "
                f"Use code {code} for a discount if you upgrade now."
            )
            try:
                self._send_email(user.email, "Your trial is ending soon", body)
            except Exception:
                logger.exception("failed to send trial reminder email to %s", user.email)
                continue
            self.notified.add(user.id)
            sent_codes[user.id] = code
        return sent_codes

    async def _loop(self) -> None:
        while True:
            await self.run_once()
            await asyncio.sleep(self._interval_seconds)

    def start(self) -> None:
        if self._task is None or self._task.done():
            self._task = asyncio.create_task(self._loop())

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        if self._task is None:
            return
        self._task.cancel()
        with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
            await self._task
        self._task = None

class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, now: datetime):
        self.now = now

    def __call__(self) -> datetime:
        return self.now

    def advance(self, **kwargs):

            make_user(2, now),  # not expiring
        ]

            clock=FakeClock(now),
            send_email=lambda to, subject, body: sent.append((to, subject, body)),
        )

class TestReminderWorkerBackgroundLoop:
    def test_start_runs_periodically_until_stopped(self):
        async def scenario():
            now = SIGNUP
            users = [make_user(1, now - timedelta(days=TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS - 1))]
            call_count = 0
            sent = asyncio.Event()

            def counting_send(to, subject, body):
                nonlocal call_count
                call_count += 1
                sent.set()

            worker = ReminderWorker(
                get_users=lambda: users,
                clock=FakeClock(now),
                send_email=counting_send,
                interval_seconds=0.01,
            )
            worker.start()
            # Wait for the loop to actually deliver the reminder, bounded by a
            # generous timeout in case the background task never runs.
            await asyncio.wait_for(sent.wait(), timeout=2)
            await worker.stop()

            # Only the first tick actually sends (user is already notified after that).
            assert call_count == 1
            assert worker._task is None

        asyncio.run(scenario())

    def test_stop_is_safe_when_never_started(self):
        worker = ReminderWorker(get_users=lambda: [], clock=FakeClock(SIGNUP))
        asyncio.run(worker.stop())

    def test_start_is_idempotent(self):
        async def scenario():
            worker = ReminderWorker(get_users=lambda: [], clock=FakeClock(SIGNUP), interval_seconds=10)
            worker.start()
            task = worker._task
            worker.start()
            assert worker._task is task
            await worker.stop()

        asyncio.run(scenario())

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Session, sessionmaker

    # A `:memory:` sqlite database is private to the connection that created it, and the
    # default pool opens a new connection per thread. Requests are handled on a different
    # thread than the one that ran `Base.metadata.create_all`, so without a single shared
    # connection every other thread would see an empty database.
    _engine_kwargs["poolclass"] = StaticPool

SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, expire_on_commit=False)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


def get_db() -> Iterator[Session]:
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:

PROFILE_URL = os.environ.get("PROFILE_URL", "http://profile-service")
NOTIFY_URL = os.environ.get("NOTIFY_URL", "http://notify-service")
PRICES_URL = os.environ.get("PRICES_URL", "http://prices-service")

MAX_CONCURRENT_PRICE_REQUESTS = 10

router = APIRouter()


async def get_http_client() -> AsyncIterator[httpx.AsyncClient]:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        yield client


async def _fetch_profile(client: httpx.AsyncClient, user_id: int) -> dict | None:
    try:
        resp = await client.get(f"{PROFILE_URL}/profile/{user_id}")
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json()
    except httpx.HTTPError:
        return None


async def _fetch_notifications(client: httpx.AsyncClient, user_id: int) -> list | None:
    try:
        resp = await client.get(f"{NOTIFY_URL}/notifications/{user_id}/unread")
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json()
    except httpx.HTTPError:
        return None


async def _fetch_prices(client: httpx.AsyncClient, tickers: list[str]) -> dict[str, object] | None:
    if not tickers:
        return {}

    semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(MAX_CONCURRENT_PRICE_REQUESTS)

    async def _fetch_one(ticker: str) -> httpx.Response:
        async with semaphore:
            return await client.get(f"{PRICES_URL}/quote/{ticker}")

    try:
        responses = await asyncio.gather(*(_fetch_one(ticker) for ticker in tickers))
        prices = {}
        for ticker, resp in zip(tickers, responses, strict=True):
            resp.raise_for_status()
            prices[ticker] = resp.json()
        return prices
    except httpx.HTTPError:
        return None


def _recent_orders(db: Session, user_id: int) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    orders = (
        db.query(Order)
        .filter(Order.user_id == user_id)
        .order_by(Order.created_at.desc())
        .limit(5)
        .all()
    )
    return [
        {
            "id": order.id,
            "status": order.status,
            "total": float(order.total),
            "created_at": order.created_at.isoformat() if order.created_at else None,
        }
        for order in orders
    ]


@router.get("/dashboard")
async def dashboard(
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    client: httpx.AsyncClient = Depends(get_http_client),
) -> dict[str, object]:
    profile_task = asyncio.create_task(_fetch_profile(client, user.id))
    notifications_task = asyncio.create_task(_fetch_notifications(client, user.id))
    orders_task = asyncio.create_task(asyncio.to_thread(_recent_orders, db, user.id))

    profile = await profile_task
    watchlist = profile.get("watchlist", []) if profile else []
    prices = await _fetch_prices(client, watchlist)
    notifications, orders = await asyncio.gather(notifications_task, orders_task)

    return {
        "profile": profile,
        "notifications": notifications,
        "prices": prices,
        "orders": orders,
    }

def _sign(body: bytes, secret: str = WEBHOOK_SECRET) -> str:
    return hmac.new(secret.encode(), body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()


def _webhook_body(order_id: int, status: str = "succeeded", payment_id: str = "pay_123") -> bytes:
    return json.dumps({"order_id": order_id, "payment_id": payment_id, "status": status}).encode()

class InvitationsController < ApplicationController
  DEFAULT_RETURN_TO = "/projects"

  def create
    project = Project.find_by(id: params[:project_id])
    return head(:not_found) if project.nil?
    return head(:forbidden) unless project.user_id == current_user&.id

    invitation = project.invitations.new(email: params[:email])

    if invitation.save
      InvitationMailer.invite(invitation).deliver_now
      render json: { id: invitation.id, email: invitation.email, token: invitation.token }, status: :created
    else
      render json: { errors: invitation.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_content
    end
  end

  def accept
    invitation = Invitation.find_by(token: params[:token])
    return head(:not_found) if invitation.nil?
    return render(json: { error: "This invitation has expired" }, status: :gone) if invitation.expired?

    invitation.accept! unless invitation.accepted?
    redirect_to safe_return_to(params[:return_to])
  end

  private

  def safe_return_to(path)
    return DEFAULT_RETURN_TO unless path.is_a?(String)
    return DEFAULT_RETURN_TO unless path.start_with?("/") && !path.start_with?("//")

    path
  end
end

# Places an order for a user's cart, charges the card, and kicks off fulfillment.
#   Checkout.new(user, [{ product_id: 1, quantity: 2 }], "tok_visa").call
class Checkout
  class Error < StandardError; end
  class OutOfStockError < Error; end

  def initialize(user, cart_items, card_token)
    @user = user
    @cart_items = cart_items
    @card_token = card_token
  end

  def call
    order = nil

    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction(requires_new: true) do
      products = Product.where(id: @cart_items.map { |item| item[:product_id] }).index_by(&:id)

      order = Order.create!(user: @user)
      total_cents = 0

      @cart_items.each do |item|
        product_id = item[:product_id]
        quantity = item[:quantity]
        product = products.fetch(product_id) { raise Error, "product #{product_id} not found" }

        raise OutOfStockError, "#{product.name} is out of stock" if product.stock < quantity

        product.update!(stock: product.stock - quantity)
        order.line_items.create!(product: product, quantity: quantity, unit_price_cents: product.price_cents)

        total_cents += product.price_cents * quantity
      end

      charge_id = PaymentGateway.charge(amount_cents: total_cents, token: @card_token)

      order.update!(total_cents: total_cents, charge_id: charge_id, status: "paid")
    end

    OrderMailer.confirmation(order).deliver_now
    FulfillmentJob.perform_later(order.id)

    order
  end
end

# One row per order placed within `from`..`to` (inclusive calendar dates).
#   SalesReport.new(Date.new(2024, 1, 1), Date.new(2024, 1, 31)).call
class SalesReport
  Row = Struct.new(:customer_name, :product_names, :total_cents, keyword_init: true)

  def initialize(from, to)
    @from = from.to_time
    @to = (to + 1).to_time
  end

  def call
    Order.where(created_at: @from...@to)
         .includes(:user, line_items: :product)
         .order(:created_at)
         .map do |order|
      Row.new(
        customer_name: order.user.name,
        product_names: order.line_items.map { |line_item| line_item.product.name },
        total_cents: order.total_cents
      )
    end
  end
end
